Jarrow Formulas and Solgar both produce B12 in methylcobalamin form, the biologically active type that the body uses directly without needing conversion in the liver.

Nerve health, red blood cell formation, and DNA synthesis all depend on adequate B12, which is why prolonged deficiency can have serious and sometimes irreversible neurological consequences. Sublingual tablets and lozenges, available from Now Foods and Life Extension, bypass absorption barriers in the gut and are particularly recommended for older adults. Vitamin K in Kenya: Benefits and What to Look For

Vitamin K is one of the most underappreciated nutrients in preventive health. Its primary role is to activate proteins that regulate where calcium is deposited in the body — directing it into bones and teeth while actively preventing it from accumulating in arteries and soft tissue. This mechanism makes vitamin K2 (as MK-7) an important cardiovascular and skeletal nutrient, particularly for anyone supplementing vitamin D3 at meaningful doses. Life Extension and Jarrow Formulas both produce MK-7 in forms shown to remain active in the bloodstream for 24 hours.

Buy Vitamin K Online in Kenya

Green leafy vegetables contain vitamin K1 in reasonable quantities, but vitamin K2 — the form most relevant to cardiovascular and bone health — is found in far fewer foods. Fermented products like natto are the richest dietary source, but these are not commonly consumed in Kenya. Supplementing with MK-7 at 90 to 200 mcg daily is a practical and well-studied approach to filling this gap. Now Foods and Solgar offer accessible options in this range.
